objective: Preserve candidate recall under moderate pressure by batching the existing RELATED_TO utility contract, instead of asking lexical pre-audit ranking to predict semantic utility it cannot observe.

productionChange.envelope: Every requested Relation id must appear exactly once with the unchanged RelationUtilityCriticVerdict schema.
productionChange.failureRecovery: Invalid or truncated multi-item output recursively splits; an invalid singleton is quarantined fail-closed.
productionChange.cache: Validated per-Relation utility verdicts retain the existing audit-version/model/temperature cache key.

frozenReplay.input: All 42 v9 pressure-source candidates after the unchanged primary semantic audit path.

forbiddenChanges: No domain-specific keywords or known Relation-id exceptions.
No weakening of the RELATED_TO utility failure modes or evidence validation.
No Stage B questions, answers or gold labels.
No direct publication from batch output.
interpretationLimits: Batching changes transport and cost, not the semantic definition of a useful edge.
The prior three per-item canonical outcomes are model diagnostics, not human gold labels.
The 64-candidate pre-audit cap remains a safety bound for larger unseen sources; it is not claimed optimal.
